sources: https://www.camplife.com/395/reservation/step1 (CampLife booking API: reservation session, park record and site records for campground 395, read 2026-10-21)

hookups.source: https://nwfwater.com/lands/recreation/area/escambia-river/mystic-springs/ ('While RV camping is allowed, the campsites do not have power, water, or waste disposal hookups.') + CampLife site records ('No Hookup. RV and Tent sites'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: The District page lists 'a group campsite, and nine individual campsites' but also calls Site Nine the group site (25 people, 10 vehicles); CampLife sells nine back-in sites, Site 9 among them, so there appear to be eight individual sites plus the group site. Individual sites hold eight people and two vehicles. CampLife accepts motorhomes, travel trailers and fifth wheels; its 50 x 50 ft on every site looks like a default, so no max rig length is recorded.

sites.source: https://nwfwater.com/lands/recreation/area/escambia-river/mystic-springs/ ('a group campsite, and nine individual campsites that are available by reservation only', 'Site Nine has a capacity of 25 people and 10 vehicles, while the individual campsites each have a capacity of eight people and two vehicles') + CampLife reservation session (site type Back-in, equipment MOTORHOME, TRAVEL TRAILER, 5TH WHEEL, TRUCK CAMPER, VAN, FOLDDOWN, TENT; Sites 1-9, width 50, maxLength 50), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Free permit booked through the District's CampLife reservation system or 850-539-5999 (a free account is needed). Up to 7 nights per reservation; no more than two reservations at a time or in a 30-day period.

booking.source: https://nwfwater.com/lands/recreation/area/escambia-river/mystic-springs/ ('available by reservation only', 'Reserve A Site' link to camplife.com/395) + https://nwfwater.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Step-by-Step-Instructions-on-How-to-Make-A-Camping-Reservation.pdf ('A reservation can be made for up to seven (7) nights. No more than two (2) reservations can be booked at a time or in a 30 day period'), read 2026-10-21

status.source: https://nwfwater.com/lands/recreation/area/escambia-river/mystic-springs/ (no closure notice on the site page) + https://nwfwater.com/lands/recreation/recreation-site-closures/ (Escambia River WMA lists only Salters Lake as closed), read 2026-10-21

note: Northwest Florida Water Management District recreation area on the Escambia River about 35 miles north of Pensacola: individual sites plus a group site, picnic tables, fire rings, charcoal grills, portable toilets, trails, a boat ramp and river swimming. Site length is not published - primitive sites on unpaved access; check the site diagram before bringing a big rig. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the District page and CampLife: reservation-only free sites that take motorhomes, no hookups, 7-night limit, CampLife booking. No Hurricane Isaias closure banner on this site and it is not on the District's closures list (recorded open). Note trimmed of the hookup/booking facts the fields carry. Not stated: real max rig length, season, potable water; the District's site count is self-contradictory (see sites.note).
